values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/esslake ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Ess Lake State Forest Campground: 27 sites, $20), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Boat launch on Ess Lake.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/esslake ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.' 'A boat launch is located on Ess Lake.') + amenity table (boat access: R), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/esslake ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + amenity table ('Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com': no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: '27 sites for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted). One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/esslake ('There are 27 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + amenity table (27 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on Ess Lake (bass, trout, panfish), 16 miles northeast of Atlanta via M-33 and County Road 624, Montmorency County; managed by Clear Lake State Park. Paddling and fishing; ORVs may be ridden from the campground to the Atlanta ORV Trail (71 miles). --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 27 sites, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed; the 15-night max had been inherited). Season (closed Dec 1 - April 15) already manual and matches the table. Phone 989-785-4388 matches (Clear Lake SP). Note trimmed of field restatements.
